text: Based on the evidence, the property (2,843.1 ha) had no detectable tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or larger between 2021 and 2025. However, this does not confirm full compliance with forest regulations (e.g., EUDR), as changes under 0.5 ha or at boundaries may have been missed. Pre-2021, there were four supported loss events (totaling 98.8 ha), but none post-baseline. The 2020 JRC reference classified the asset as 0% forest. While no major post-baseline deforestation was detected, the evidence does not guarantee compliance, as smaller or unresolved changes could exist. Legal compliance would require additional ground-truthing or higher-resolution monitoring.
